description: Winner of the Telegram design competition.

hero.alt: The redesigned Telegram for Android: the attachment menu with two photos selected slides down to the group chat, then opens again over the chat

competition.title: The competition
description: Telegram held a competition for UI designers, with $15,000 in prizes. The task was to redesign the chat screen and the attachment menu of the Android app, with the focus on sharing photos and videos. My entry made the top 15 and won $1,000.
Entries were judged on simplicity, usability and consistency. Telegram later posted my video on its Telegram Designers channel.

result.description: After the results came out, Telegram support wrote to me and asked for my bank details to send the prize.
